title: Path of Exile 2 0.3.0 Act 4 & Interludes: Non-Linear Islands, Cruel Removal and New Leveling Routes
summary: 0.3.0 added Act 4's non-linear eight-island structure, removed Cruel Difficulty, and inserted three temporary Interludes to Level 65. This page explains the new campaign flow and why old Campaign guides are wrong.
description: A campaign-structure history of 0.3.0: Act 4's non-linear islands, the removal of Cruel Difficulty, the three Interludes that bridge to Level 65, boss and leveling-build impact, and an audit of outdated Campaign guides.
author: StratLore Editorial
imageAlt: Path of Exile 2 act boss Jamanra

sections.title: Quick summary
paragraphs: 0.3.0 restructured the back half of the campaign act 4 arrived as a non linear set of eight islands cruel difficulty was removed and three temporary interludes were inserted to carry characters from the end of act 3 to level 65
If an old campaign guide tells you to run cruel or follow a linear act 4 it predates 0.3.0 and is wrong for the current client
bullets: Act 4 non linear eight island structure
Old repeat acts on cruel routes obsolete
Leveling and boss approach guides need updates

sections.title: Campaign before/after
sections.oldText: Acts 1-3, then replay the story on Cruel Difficulty to keep leveling and reach endgame.
sections.newText: Acts 1-3 → Act 4 (eight non-linear islands) → three Interludes → Level 65 → Endgame. No Cruel.

cards.detail: Act 4 is a set of eight islands you traverse in a flexible order, not a fixed corridor.
The island structure eases the jump from Act 3 into the Level 65 gate.
Linear Act 4 walkthroughs no longer match the island layout.

changes.title: Three temporary Interludes
changes.detail: Inserted after Act content to push characters to Level 65 before Endgame, replacing the old Cruel grind.

changes.title: Level 65 gate
changes.detail: Endgame entry is gated at Level 65, reached via the Interludes rather than Cruel replay.

changes.title: Removed Cruel Difficulty
changes.detail: Cruel was deleted; its replay loop is gone from the campaign.

bosses.name: Act 4 island bosses
bosses.detail: The eight islands each present bosses in a flexible order; old fixed-sequence boss guides are inaccurate.
bosses.action: Update boss-order guidance to the island model.

bosses.name: Interlude bosses
bosses.detail: The three Interludes include setpiece bosses that gate progression to Level 65.
bosses.action: Document Interlude boss approaches separately from Acts.

rows.name: Campaign / leveling guide
rows.action: Rewrite route; remove Cruel, add island + Interlude pathing.

rows.name: Boss approach guides
rows.action: Replace fixed boss order with island model.

rows.issue: Tells players to run Cruel Difficulty after Act 3.
rows.action: Replace with Act 4 islands + three Interludes to L65.

rows.issue: Relies on Cruel replay for levels.

rows.currentSummary: The non-linear eight-island Act 4 remains in 0.5.4e.
Removed in 0.3.0; no longer part of the campaign.
The Interlude bridge to Level 65 is still how you reach Endgame.

items.question: Where did Cruel Difficulty go?
answer: Removed in 0.3.0 after acts 1 3 you go to act 4 islands then three interludes to reach level 65 and endgame

items.question: Is Act 4 a straight line like earlier Acts?
answer: No act 4 is a non linear set of eight islands you traverse in a flexible order

items.question: How do I reach Endgame now?
answer: Through the three interludes that carry you to level 65 that is the endgame entry gate
